name: Single-Atomic High-Quality Robust Variant (HQS1R)
aliases: High-Quality Shader with Single Atomic Reduction
High-Quality Shader with Single Atomic Reduction (HQS1R)
Robust high-quality shading with overflow protection
definition: A high-quality point rendering method that computes average colors of overlapping points within a depth range using a single 64-bit atomic operation per point in the fast path, with overflow protection via fallback buffers to prevent artifacts when more than 255 points contribute to a pixel.
